# How rules are checked

> Every check the component rules name: what it does, which WCAG criterion it backs, and when it runs.

Part of the [Nate Mills Design System](../README.md). Every rule on a [component page](../components/README.md) names one of these checks. Automated checks run on natemills.me before every publish; the scripts live in the private source repository. All foundations: [Foundations](README.md).

## Automated

### Touch-target lint

- **Kind:** Automated
- **What it checks:** Reads the CSS and fails if a control's pointer target drops below 44px, or below the 24px floor for the documented dense size, including the invisible hit areas around small glyphs.
- **WCAG:** 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum), AA; 2.5.5 Target Size (Enhanced), AAA
- **When it runs:** Every pull request and every deploy.
- **Rules it checks:** [Button](../components/button.md#rules), [Carousel navigation](../components/carousel-navigation.md#rules)

### Focus-ring gate

- **Kind:** Automated
- **What it checks:** Presses Tab to every control in a real browser, in both themes, and compares the pixels at rest and focused. It fails if no ring appears, or if the ring is under 3:1 against what is behind it.
- **WCAG:** 2.4.7 Focus Visible, AA; 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast, AA
- **When it runs:** Every deploy.
- **Rules it checks:** [Button](../components/button.md#rules), [Card](../components/card.md#rules), [Link](../components/link.md#rules)

### State-contrast gate

- **Kind:** Automated
- **What it checks:** Hovers, focuses and presses every control in a real browser, in both themes, and measures the text and glyph against the control's own background: 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for an icon.
- **WCAG:** 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum), AA; 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast, AA
- **When it runs:** Every deploy.
- **Rules it checks:** [Button](../components/button.md#rules), [Card](../components/card.md#rules)

### axe accessibility scan

- **Kind:** Automated
- **What it checks:** Runs axe-core's WCAG 2.2 A and AA rules on every page state in both themes, including the rules that every button has a name and every image has alt text.
- **WCAG:** WCAG 2.2 A and AA, including 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value and 1.1.1 Non-text Content
- **When it runs:** Every deploy.
- **Rules it checks:** [Button](../components/button.md#rules), [Carousel navigation](../components/carousel-navigation.md#rules), [Avatar](../components/avatar.md#rules)
- **Reference:** [github.com/dequelabs](https://github.com/dequelabs/axe-core/blob/develop/doc/rule-descriptions.md)

### External-link lint

- **Kind:** Automated
- **What it checks:** Reads the pages and fails any link that leaves the site without `target="_blank"`, `rel="noopener noreferrer"`, the trailing `arrow-up-right` glyph and an "opens in a new tab" cue.
- **WCAG:** 3.2.5 Change on Request, AAA (advisory)
- **When it runs:** Every pull request and every deploy.
- **Rules it checks:** [Button](../components/button.md#rules), [Link](../components/link.md#rules), [Screen-reader text](../components/screen-reader-text.md#rules)

### Underline gate

- **Kind:** Automated
- **What it checks:** Resolves the cascade for every link in a real browser, in every state, and fails any link that shows no underline, or two.
- **WCAG:** House rule; it keeps links in text from relying on colour alone (1.4.1 Use of Color, A)
- **When it runs:** Every deploy.
- **Rules it checks:** [Link](../components/link.md#rules)

### Keyboard gate

- **Kind:** Automated
- **What it checks:** Walks the page with real key presses: no positive tabindex, the skip link first, focus returning from overlays, and carousel tracks that are Tab stops only while they can scroll.
- **WCAG:** 2.1.1 Keyboard, A; 2.4.3 Focus Order, A; 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured (Minimum), AA
- **When it runs:** Every deploy.
- **Rules it checks:** [Carousel navigation](../components/carousel-navigation.md#rules)

### Mobile-consistency lint

- **Kind:** Automated
- **What it checks:** Reads the CSS and fails if a card natemills.me registers as static grows a hover state of its own, among other mobile layout rules.
- **WCAG:** House rule
- **When it runs:** Every pull request and every deploy.
- **Rules it checks:** [Card](../components/card.md#rules)

### Section-head gate

- **Kind:** Automated
- **What it checks:** Measures, in a real browser, the gap under every section heading and fails if anything other than the section-head block sets it.
- **WCAG:** House rule
- **When it runs:** Every deploy.
- **Rules it checks:** [Section heading](../components/section-heading.md#rules)

### Image-size checks

- **Kind:** Automated
- **What it checks:** Every `<img>` must carry `width` and `height`, and the img-ratio lint fails when those two numbers describe a different shape from the image file.
- **WCAG:** House rule; it stops the page shifting as images load
- **When it runs:** Every pull request and every deploy (the ratio lint); the presence check runs whenever a page is edited.
- **Rules it checks:** [Avatar](../components/avatar.md#rules)

## Manual

### Design review

- **Kind:** Manual
- **What it checks:** Checked by hand when a change is reviewed, because no automated check can judge it.
- **WCAG:** Varies by rule
- **When it runs:** Every change, by hand.
- **Rules it checks:** [Button](../components/button.md#rules), [Card](../components/card.md#rules), [Loading card](../components/loading-card.md#rules), [Chip](../components/chip.md#rules), [Badge](../components/badge.md#rules), [Section heading](../components/section-heading.md#rules), [Link](../components/link.md#rules), [Carousel navigation](../components/carousel-navigation.md#rules), [Screen-reader text](../components/screen-reader-text.md#rules)
